name: sawmill-tycoon-android
description: Sawmill Tycoon (Pilana Tajkun) for Android, packaged with Capacitor. The game is not built: pack.mjs copies it into www/.

scripts.sync: node pack.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: node pack.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.bundle: node pack.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
